info.name: Bridge API (Bridge Data Output) Agents Listings API

params.name: dataset_id
params.description: The dataset identifier the request is scoped to.

params.name: access_token
params.description: Bridge access token. Optional when an Authorization Bearer header is supplied.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in each record.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: Field name to sort results by.

params.name: near
params.description: Geographic point as "longitude,latitude" used for radius/near search.

items.docs: Returns normalized listing/property records for the given dataset. Supports field selection, sorting, geo (near) search, pagination, and per-field filter operators such as ListPrice.gt or City.eq.

info.name: Get a single listing by id

params.name: dataset_id
params.description: The dataset identifier the request is scoped to.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of a single resource record.

params.name: access_token
params.description: Bridge access token. Optional when an Authorization Bearer header is supplied.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in each record.

items.docs: Get a single listing by id
